profile.headline: Software Engineer, IT Manager
profile.summary: You know that one person who's the keeper of the institutional knowledge and the silent fixer of all the things? The one you go to when you have a knotty logistical problem to untangle? That's who I am. Ad-hoc lead developer, project manager, solutions architect, and wearer of assorted other hats. Two decades plus of experience in development, design, UX, accessibility, content provider solutions, analytics, SEO, and more.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Emerged as a key player in the transformation of the SEPTA website into what may be the country's best digital presence for public transit:
- Single-handedly completed the Phase I flagship site rebuild, sifting through nearly 25,000 URLs of old static pages to consolidate viable content a 1,000-page WordPress site with a custom theme and plugin. Refreshed the 14-year-old design and merged separate desktop and mobile versions of the site into a single mobile-friendly website while reducing page download times by 1/2 to 2/3.
- Collaborated with SEPTA staff and consultants on Phase II: the planning, rebuild, and relaunch of the flagship site as a hybrid WP/JS web presence integrating real-time data. Consulted on data structure, wrote new code and facilitated further content migrations. Formulated creative solutions for a unified sitewide search and 404 handling across domains and built the sitewide search.
- Took charge of managing SEO, Google Analytics, and Tag Manager.
- Continuing the collaboration beyond Phase II to migrate content from secondary SEPTA websites into the flagship site, expanding front-end functionality and building new workflows for content providers. Tackles special projects, such as support for online advertising, as they arise.
- Leading the initiative to refresh and streamline the codebase for the Office of Inspector General website.
- Providing day-to-day support for content providers' feature requests; manages routine system updates; implements code and performance improvements; takes point on QA reviews such as link checks, ADA compliance checks and tests of the sitewide search; and oversees the local WordPress codebase and Github repositories.

Ongoing WordPress development for SEPTA incorporates a range of APIs and features, including custom post types and taxonomies, custom roles and capabilities, custom fields, settings pages, WP Cron tasks, WP Query modifications, and data integration involving WP REST and external APIs.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Reimagined the company's public-facing web presence for multiple brands and implemented sweeping improvements to code, design, and practices:
- Redesigned/rebuilt the flagship site and rebuilt secondary brand sites for code stability and improved performance.
- Completed performance improvements reducing page download times by 50 to 80 percent.
- Introduced new features such as a sitewide search, a working blog, calculators, and support for Spanish-language content.
- Implemented multiple layers of security across sites.
- Brought the sites into ADA compliance.
- Successfully migrated the company's public sites to reliable web hosting.
- Wrote multiple custom WP themes and plugins and set up Git versioning and repositories for company code.
- Reconfigured Google Analytics, Search Console and Tag Manager for better alignment with company needs and best practices.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Managed the CMS installations and performed long-term strategic planning for the campus managed hosting service on WordPress multisite with an eye to best practices in security, privacy, performance, UX, accessibility, mobile support and SEO.
- Created Rutgers-branded custom themes for departmental and personal web sites.
- Developed plugins to tailor WP to the needs of university content providers and to automate site 
- Set up and monitored Google Analytics, Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools for WP and many Drupal sites on campus.
- Configured Google Tag Manager for Google Analytics and Facebook Pixel tracking and implemented Salesforce integration using Gravity Forms and Pardot.
maintenance.
- Researched and tested third-party WP themes, plugins, maintenance scripts and code snippets to meet common feature requests.
- Provided troubleshooting, training and documentation for web content technicians.
- Managed Camden IT communications and graphic design: Twitter, campus message boards, web slides and backgrounds for the department’s green-screen photo booth.

positions.title: Web Developer 1
positions.locationName: Sul Ross State University, Alpine, Texas
positions.description:
- Administered the Sitebuilder content management system used for official university sites.
- Built a file management system to meet new state laws requiring the publication of searchable course syllabi and faculty CVs.
- Created small web applications and complex web forms for alumni and prospective student transactions.
- Created a multipurpose PHP code library with functions for form processing, file management, email messaging, GPG encryption and Active Directory authentication.
- Worked closely with Windows/IIS and Linux/Apache server administrators on configuration and management, developing scheduled tasks/cron jobs to automate routine web maintenance and reporting.
- Established and administered a dedicated space for faculty and staff members' personal websites.

positions.title: Web Content Technician
positions.locationName: Sul Ross State University, Alpine, Texas
positions.description: Administered the Sitebuilder content management system used for official university sites. Restructured the content architecture and rewrote much of the content for the university's main site, www.sulross.edu. Built web forms and small applications. Trained and supported departmental web content providers via workshops and individual sessions.
